summary: Cantor Equity Partners I, Inc. (Nasdaq: CEPO) filed an 8-K reporting a further postponement of its extraordinary general meeting to July 10, 2026, for shareholder approval of its proposed initial business combination with BSTR Holdings, Inc. The meeting, originally June 26, was delayed to solicit additional proxies. Shareholders may redeem Class A ordinary shares by July 8, 2026. No price, premium, or advisor details are disclosed. This is a routine SPAC extension filing to push the vote on the de-SPAC deal. Watch the redemption deadline and whether the business combination receives sufficient shareholder support to avoid liquidation.
